description: Build improved temporal_stability enrichment module to fix BAD SIGNAL (4 distinct values across 34 fingerprints). Current temporal_stability signal has only 4 distinct values, range 30-90 — this discriminates poorly and must be improved. New module must expose compute_score(metadata: dict) -> tuple[float, dict] using multiple fields: first_seen (compute age_days), last_modified (compute update_cadence_days), commit_frequency (if present), registry_source (NPM vs GitHub vs PyPI has different stability expectations), download_count (proxy for maturity). Score range [0-100]. Pure function, no DB writes, no network, no imports of protected modules. Must yield >20 distinct scores across 34 synthetic fingerprints. Reference: signal model section 3, enrichment contract section 7.
